messages:
anna: heads-up  i'm about to open a tiny PR to tighten the 429 & timeout section in the error reference. current page has two competing snippets and a stale SDK anchor. i'll add a compact JS snippet, a short Rust example (ops requested), a Retry-After parser note, and fix the links. pushing in ~15m.
bilal: rust example is helpful  ops asks for it for internal tooling. keep it minimal: header-first, fallback to capped exp backoff with jitter.
frodo: also add a note about Retry-After values being either seconds or an http-date (tz/parsing edgecases). maybe call out servers that return negative dates if clocks skew. one line is enough.
nashwin: please use the exact hosted SDK call in JS so customers can copy-paste: `await redwood.generate({ model: 'redwood-small', input: prompt, retry: { maxRetries: 3, baseMs: 150, capMs: 5000, jitter: true } })`.
docs-bot: linkcheck: broken link "/docs/sdk/retries-old" referenced in error-reference/429.md -> 404 (reported 40m ago)
anna: thanks bot  updated link to `/docs/sdk/retries-guide#examples` in draft and added a small CI linkcheck step for anchors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1616
bilal: would be good to add a one-liner in runtime FAQ linking to this page explaining that runtime trims input to model limits before fallback selection. reduces support churn.
carla: tiny wording nit: under fallback guidance prefer: "Use a model variant fallback when fidelity matters. Use quantized or lower-latency variants when cost/latency is the priority." keeps expectations explicit.
frodo: for the Rust snippet, show a tiny helper `parse_retry_after` that returns Duration and handles both numeric and RFC1123 dates. ops will appreciate it.
anna: added JS + Rust + one-sentence runtime cross-ref and the changelog entry. assigned to @carla for final review. once CI is green i'll merge and post a short blurb to #support.
carla: quick pass done, left one tiny grammar nit. CI rerun requested. will merge once green. :shipit:
anna: thanks all  will post after merge.
